#
# Development files that must not ship. One pattern per line, relative to an
# app root (or core/, settings/), shell globs allowed, written the way an app's
# .nextcloudignore lists them so lines can be copied over as they are.
#
# clean-dev-files.sh removes every match, with its .license sidecar, and the
# release build reports each one as missing from that app's .nextcloudignore.
#
# composer.json, composer.lock, package.json and package-lock.json are kept on
# purpose: a release records what it was built from.
